sections.title: charaNam 1
lyrics: nirupama karuNA varuNAlaya shrI dharaNikarA sArasa sEvitha padhA

sections.title: charaNam 2
lyrics: bhUri lAvaNyA *bhuvunaika* sAmanyA thAraka sindhu kanyA
sarasija vadana sarasija nayanA sarasija charaNa

sections.title: charaNam 3
lyrics: ara shankarArdhAngayuga dhara sarasija bhavanutha padhayugaLa
ravikula *sambhava* raghu *budha* *vasukarArcitha* *shubha* vigrahA

sections.title: charaNam 4
lyrics: pApaharA tApaharA pApa daityA samhArA - pAvanajAla *pUrNAbhaya* kAvEri vihArA
sapta prakArAbhyantara samsthAnE satpraNavAkA hE - sarasija *kuTmala* sadrushE vilasita para vAsudEva

sections.title: charaNam 5
lyrics: hE garuDa khaga turangA paripAlita rangA paramamuni
hrudaya sarasA sArangA varadA bhayadAmara dhAnavanuthA
vairi madavibhangA nIla jaladi dEhA kShIra jaladi gEhA
dOSha virahita harE shESha shayana shaurE sadaya hrudaya
